notes: Verbatim mirror of the Figma Variables in this library. Not reconciled against
assets/tokens.json or assets/figma-mappings.json — it is an independent source.
Alias values carry a resolved `target` when the destination variable exists in
either Figma library; `null` means it could not be resolved.
